id.description:
Unique identifier generated by PayPlaza for this transaction.
Format will be 31 numeric characters

allOf.description:
Datetime identifying the moment the transaction was created at CM.com and in CM.com timezone.
The creation date is specified in the ISO 8601 format.
The date on the receipt is formatted to the store timezone. pattern: "ISO 8601: "YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ssZ"

merchant_order_reference.description: Identifier provided by the merchant when creating the transaction.

brand.description:
Optional field, which will only be filled if this transaction is authorized by a processor.

Identifies the brand on the bankcard of the consumer, possible values:
AMEX, CIRRUS, CUP, DINERS, DISCOVER, JCB, MAESTRO, MASTERCARD, VISA, V_PAY.

system_trace_audit_number.description:
Optional field, which will only be filled if this transaction is authorized by a processor.

Identifier generated by PayPlaza to trace a transaction through its lifecycle with a processor.
* Format is a 6 digit number, but should be treated as a string.
* Unique per day per processor, so not unique for merchants.

receipt.description:
Optional field, which will only be filled if this transaction cleared or cancelled.

Plain text description of the transaction, contains required information needed to print a proof of the transaction of the consumer.

merchant_receipt.description:
Optional field.

Plain text description of the transaction, contains required information needed to print a proof of the transaction of the merchant.

original_id.description:
Optional field, which will only be filled if this transaction is a REFUND.

This field contains the id of the original PURCHASE transaction to which this transaction is a refund.

authorization_code.description:
Optional field, which will only be filled if this transaction is authorized by a processor.

This field contains the authentication provided by the processor of the transaction.

merchant_id.description: Identifier of the merchant that initiated this transaction.

processor_terminal_id.description:
Optional field, which will only be filled after this transaction is authorized.

Terminal ID provided by the processor of the transaction.

Amount.description:
Describes how much money the transaction should be.
'value' is a number value with a dot (.) as decimal separator. It should NOT have any digit grouping or thousands separators
'currency' is a 3-letter-code, compliant with ISO 4217

Store1.title: StoreSummary
Store1.description: Information about Store where merchant can do transactions.

TransactionResult.description: Final outcome of processing the transaction.<dl><dt>APPROVED</dt><dd>Indicates that the bank of the consumer authorized the payment.</dd><dt>DECLINED</dt><dd>Indicates that the bank of the consumer does NOT approve the payment.</dd></dl>

TransactionStatus.description:
Current state of a transaction.
CREATED
Transaction is created and waiting authorization.
AUTHORIZED
Transaction is authorized and awaiting clearance.
CLEARED
Transaction is cleared and is completed successfully.
CANCELLED
Transaction is cancelled and is completed unsuccessfully.

TransactionType.description: <dl><dt>PURCHASE</dt><dd>Indicates a purchase where the money will flow from the consumer to the merchant</dd><dt>PRE_AUTH</dt><dd>Indicates a claim on a certain amount of money on the bankaccount of the consumer</dd><dt>REFUND</dt><dd>Indicates a refunds where the money will flow from the merchant back to the consumer</dd></dl>
